title: Scoreboard
description:
Read a count `n`, then `n` whole-number scores. Store them in a `std::vector<int>` and print:

```
Scores: 5
Highest: 95
Lowest: 61
Average: 79.4
```

The average has one decimal place. If `n` is 0, print only `No scores`.
hints: Start `highest` and `lowest` at the first score, not at 0: with 0 as the starting point, a list of all-negative or all-large numbers gives the wrong answer.
